{{Otheruses|Cairn}}
'''Cairn's Flying Circus''' was a traveling [[Circus/Legends|circus]] that performed in the [[Minos Cluster/Legends|Minos Cluster]]. The circus included a foul-tempered [[Abyssin/Legends|Abyssin]], two mutating [[Alien/Legends|aliens]], three [[Clown/Legends|clowns]], six [[Af'El lion]]s and their trainer, a [[Kitonak/Legends|Kitonak]] band, and [[Acrobat/Legends|acrobat]] and her [[strong-man]] boyfriend, a [[Togorian/Legends|Togorian]] [[Knife/Legends|knife]]-thrower, and the [[ringmaster]]. In reality, Cairn's Flying Circus was comprised of [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance]] [[Spy/Legends|spies]] sent by [[No-Holds-Barred]] to search for [[Drun Cairnwick/Legends|Drun Cairnwick]].

==Behind the scenes==
A [[Wikipedia:Cairn|cairn]] is a term derived from [[Wikipedia:Scottish Gaelic|Scottish Gaelic]] that refers to artificial stone piles in the real world. It is not known if the Circus was linked in any way to the city of [[Cairn (city)|Cairn]] on [[Seikosha/Legends|Seikosha]], to the [[Asteroid/Legends|asteroid]] [[Cairn]] or to the [[Rodian/Legends|Rodian]] [[Cairn Clan]].
